title: Sr. Computer Vision Engineer
description: Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision Engineer with strong experience in video analytics, computer vision, real-time streaming and high-throughput telemetry pipelines . The role focuses on designing, scaling and deploying computer vision pipelines that process large numbers of live CCTV feeds and deliver real-time intelligence to centralized Command & Control (C2), Video Management System (VMS) and operational monitoring platforms . The engineer will work across computer vision, edge video processing, multi-camera tracking, event streaming, enterprise integration and performance optimization . Key Responsibilities Design and develop scalable Python/C++ video analytics pipelines for concurrent processing of hundreds of live camera feeds. Build solutions using NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer, OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow and related computer vision frameworks. Convert computer vision outputs such as bounding boxes, object IDs and tracking information into structured JSON/Protobuf telemetry . Integrate real-time alerts with Kafka, MQTT, RabbitMQ, gRPC or similar event/message brokers. Develop multi-camera tracking and person/vehicle re-identification (Re-ID) capabilities. Implement spatial-temporal tracking to map subjects across cameras and physical locations. Develop middleware/plugins for integration with Video Management Systems (VMS), NVRs, CCTV platforms and enterprise security systems . Integrate video analytics with Command & Control / Smart City / operational monitoring platforms . Optimize inference pipelines using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime and GPU acceleration. Profile and benchmark systems to maintain sub-second end-to-end latency for real-time command-center applications. Work with real-time video streaming technologies including RTSP, WebRTC, SRT and HLS . Integrate perimeter security technologies such as virtual tripwires, laser barriers and IoT occupancy sensors . Interface with physical security and hardware layers including dry-contact relays, Wiegand-to-IP converters, OSDP and PLCs . Troubleshoot performance, networking, streaming and integration issues across distributed video analytics environments. Contribute to system architecture, technical documentation, deployment and production support. Required Skills & Experience Experience 5+ years of overall software engineering experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience in large-scale video analytics, computer vision or real-time video telemetry . Experience integrating video analytics with C2, VMS, Smart City, security monitoring or operational command platforms .
